game.title: Resident Evil 4
game.blurb: Survival horror action game, a remake of the 2005 Resident Evil 4, from Capcom, released 2023-03-24. RAWG average playtime: 24 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Resident_Evil_4_(2023)
Fandom (residentevil.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://residentevil.fandom.com/wiki/Resident_Evil_4_(2023_game)
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2023 remake, with its own Steam app 2050650 ("Resident Evil 4"); the 2005 original is app 254700. StrategyWiki has the remake under "Resident Evil 4 (2023)" (completion stage 0, marked as a stub); only its "Achievements and trophies" and "Table of Contents" subpages are written, with no walkthrough, so nothing was used. residentevil.fandom.com answers the API under "Resident Evil 4 (2023 game)", with about 319 linked articles, mostly cast and crew; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 13 of 46 Steam achievements are hidden. "The Perfect Mission" and "Ada the \"S+\"py" sit at the very end of the Steam list, right after the two Separate Ways achievements, and one names Ada, so they were put in the Separate Ways chapter; "Peerless Agent" sits between the Hardcore and speed-run achievements, so it was put with difficulty. Both are guesses from position and need checking. The other 10 hidden ones (names such as "Harpoon Hurler", "Giant Slayer" and "Had Enough of Preachers") read like boss fights and sit in the story chapter. RAWG lists Separate Ways as its own entry (2023-09-21).
